title: Shopify removes the metafieldInteger collection condition in API version 2027-01
summary: As of Admin API version 2027-01, the metafieldInteger collection source condition inputs and types are removed and replaced by metafieldInt, whose value is a String instead of an Int.
migrationNote: Before moving to 2027-01, replace metafieldInteger with metafieldInt in collection condition inputs and reads (CollectionSourceInclusionConditionMetafieldInt), and send the value as a String.
